mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, m.name AS movieName, m.poster_url AS posterUrl, h.name AS hallName, h.location, s.start_time AS startTime, o.total_price AS totalPrice, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN session s ON s.id = oi.session_id JOIN movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY o.id, o.order_no, m.name, m.poster_url, h.name, h.location, s.start_time, o.total_price, o.status, o.create_time ORDER BY o.create_time DESC;

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.total_price AS totalPrice, o.status, o.create_time AS createTime, o.pay_time AS payTime, m.name AS movieName, m.poster_url AS posterUrl, h.name AS hallName, h.location, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.language_version AS languageVersion, oi.seat_row AS seatRow, oi.seat_col AS seatCol, oi.price AS ticketPrice FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN session s ON s.id = oi.session_id JOIN movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND o.user_id = #{userId}
